text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hm, hm, hmm-hm-hmm...♪
My photobomb streak is going great! Whose
video should I pop into today...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"......Whoa, mm! This notification is...
A mega Tsuji-chance! I must make
haste...!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"......Oops. Well, well... Journey and
Orfe.
As close as ever, you two. So... did you
need something from me?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
By royal decree—from this day forth, you
shall go nowhere.
You have frolicked to your heart's content
and had your fill... but I shall not
permit it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let us witness together what kind of
conclusion our "little game" will lead to—
back at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"......Yup, looks like pretty much
everyone is here! Thanks for coming, you
guys!
I'm recording an emergency video right
now! And the reason is~~..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! 'What's the counter above...?' Yes,
exactly!
It shows the current number of
subscribers! See, isn't it an amazing
number~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"And with that! We are kicking off our
'Watch Together! Live Stream to 100
Million Milestone'♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the view count is totally
skyrocketing~!
Thank you so much, everyone~! Still-chan,
wanna reply to some comments?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes... um... ...Eek, so fast...!
W-Whoa, ah... u-um...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... "So happy to see lots of
Still-chan"...
"Thanks for the video"... No, thank *you*
so much...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heyyy, won't you give Pandora-chan a
comment too? ...Wait...
"Here comes the fully licensed princess"
"I cried during that raging torrent
elopement lesson"...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heyyy~! Nothing about me being cute—...
Huh, w-wait?
"You worked so hard," "Amazing," "Great
job," "The bungee jump moved me to tears"!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"......Aww~~~ they're praising me so much!
Hehehe, thank you, thank you~♡ Pretty
amazing, right, Pandora-chan?♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! And while we're talking, it just hit
90 million~~!
Whoa, aren't we gonna hit it in no time at
all!? Everyone, get ready to celebrate!

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"'We've surpassed 95 million people...!
Thank you so much, everyone.
The comments are so warm, too... Fufu, I'm
glad I found the courage to do this...'"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"............ I have to run. I'm... not
like these girls.
After all, I have nothing... but
'racing.'"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah, we passed 97 million...! Keep
tearing ahead just like that!
Go! Pass them, pass theeeem, damn it
allllll!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
99 million reached~~~~!!
Just the final stretch... until 100
million!! Almost there!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
――Incredible...!
We're truly... truly going to achieve
it...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, here we go!
Ready, set...... go!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
100 million reached!
Thank you sooooo much~~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"......I really, truly pulled it
off......!
......"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Once again! Everyone, thank you so, so
much for watching so many of our videos
and supporting this project... ♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I see all your comments on the videos and
reactions on social media!
All of us Umamusume... feel the love from
your heartwarming messages♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll turn everyone's cheers into power and
keep on running♪
Next up, a special 100-million-subscriber
project! Replying to 100 million thank-you
comments~♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... W-We managed to
return... so many of them...
Ah... is it about time? Should we... give
the closing remarks...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait~! Look... check this out!
My subscriber count kept going up during
the stream, you know? And so—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Loves-chan, ready? Here it comes...
ta-da!!
In the end, it increased all the way to
this...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaaaa!? Are you for real~~~~!?
Th-That's... a-ma-zing...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"............ Seriously. Like, I took it
super lightly at first, you know?
Thinking, '100 million? Totally doable~~'
But..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"When I think about how many people
actually showed up for me...
Seriously, thank you so, sooooo much,
everyone!!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes... My gratitude for everyone's love...
Thank you, truly, from the bottom of my
heart.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it feels like we're wrapping things
up, but... aren't you forgetting one
thing?
Curren and the gang have another big
project in the works♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Oh yeah, to celebrate reaching our
goal and to show our thanks...
We're premiering a brand new music video
right now! *Clap clap*♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone remembered♪ I'm so happy,
thank you~♡
I put lots and lots of love into it, so I
hope you enjoy it♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And listen! People usually watch MVs in
landscape mode, right?
But this time... I really want you to
watch it in portrait!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, just like Loves-chan!
...Fufu, are you getting excited? Keep
those expectations high♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's a song packed full of cuteness,
written with someone special in mind♡
Now then, please enjoy♪ Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: 『Menishuki♡ Rush-shu!』
